info.title: ContentDesigner
info.description: Content Designer: the four-view arrangement of posts (Mobile, Tablet, Desktop, AMP), document and block templates, the design checks, and the server HTML and AMP pages.

get.summary: One page of post designs, the latest change first; optionally of one kind.
A post's design: its four-view draft and its published state.

post.summary: Make the post's design from a template, else the kind's default template, else the starter; 409 if it has one.

put.summary: Replace the draft's four views; 409 if the design changed since 'version' or a view breaks a structural rule.

delete.summary: Delete the post's design and its published state.

put.summary: Arrange one view (mobile, tablet, desktop, amp): its regions and placements, or inherit another view.

post.summary: Take a document template's views (all, or the ones named) into the draft.
Check the draft (or the unsaved views sent): design rules, DynamicFields validation, JSON-LD essentials, the AMP page; with the JSON-LD.
The draft (or the unsaved views sent) rendered as the responsive page or the AMP page.
Publish the draft once every check passes (409 lists the errors); pins the content revisions it was checked against.
Take the published design down; the public pages answer 404.

get.summary: The studio's workspace of a post: the post and its contents (Content), the renderer's document, the kind's values, the fields' style tokens and the design (null when none).
The post's change feed after an event id (Content's): read the next page with after = last.
Content's shared library (the contents the caller may see, archived ones left out), for adding an existing content to a post.
One content of the library with its values, as the renderer's block.

post.summary: Add an existing content of the library to the post (Content's attach, at the post's version; 409 when the post changed). Returns the workspace.

get.summary: The post kinds a template or design can be for: DynamicFields' root post fields, with their URL prefixes.
The Organization units' names, for filters; empty when Organization is not there or does not answer the caller.
What the caller may do with the post's design now: arrange and publish on its unit, press or categories (a shift's rights come and go).
The document templates, by kind and name; optionally of one kind.

post.summary: A new document template for a kind; makeDefault makes it the kind's default.

delete.summary: Delete a document template; designs made from it keep their views.

put.summary: Make a template its kind's default (the kind's other default stops being one), or not.

post.summary: Save the post's draft as a document template of its kind (the post's own contents fall into items).

get.summary: The block templates; optionally of one block field and one view.

delete.summary: Delete a block template; the checks report placements that still name it.

post.summary: Save how a content (content:{id}) is placed in a view as a block template of its field; withContent keeps its values; design: the unsaved views (default: the stored draft).

get.summary: The published post as its designed responsive HTML page.
The published post as its designed AMP page.
